translations.source:
Use at your own risk. We make no guarantees this will work for you. 
 1. This feature may not work on this device, yet work on others 
 2. Some speed options may not work on this device, yet work on others 
 3. Roku may block this feature without warning; even if the Jellyfin client doesn't update

Använd på egen risk. Vi garanterar inte att detta fungerar för dig. 
 1. Funktionen kanske inte fungerar på enheten men på andra.

translations.source: Force live TV to be transcoded. If All Playable Media is already set to Force Transcode (Remux Disabled), this setting is ignored.
